threat_event: Attacker on the Terminal T1 office network changes tank gauging or loading rack logic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rack and gauging PLCs share a network segment with the terminal office; default passwords found on 4 gauging interface units
existing_controls: OT sensor at Terminal T1; independent high-level alarms
treatment_plan: Separate the rack and gauging PLCs into an OT segment behind the terminal OT firewall
owner: Distribution Cybersecurity Officer (CySO) for Terminal T1

threat_event: Integrator session through the group gateway reaches Terminal T1 automation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared integrator accounts on the gateway
existing_controls: MFA; session recording at Terminal T1
treatment_plan: Named accounts and per-session approval (group plan GR-01)
owner: Distribution Cybersecurity Officer (CySO) for Terminal T1

threat_event: Untrained contractor personnel misuse or are tricked into misusing OT access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 contractor personnel with OT access missed the 2026-01-12 training deadline and were not accompanied or monitored
treatment_plan: Train or escort all 23 by 2026-10-31; block access for anyone untrained after that date
owner: Distribution Cybersecurity Officer (CySO) for Terminal T1

threat_event: The Cybersecurity Plan is not submitted by 2027-07-16
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan not drafted; Assessment not started; network map from 2022
owner: Distribution Cybersecurity Officer (CySO) for Terminal T1

threat_event: Default passwords let an attacker read or change tank gauging data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default vendor passwords on 4 tank gauging interface units, reachable from the office network (changed 2026-09-10)
treatment_plan: Sweep all Terminal T1 OT devices for defaults; add to commissioning checklist

threat_event: Attacker logs into the telemetry vendor portal and pushes bad configuration or firmware to customer gateways
existing_controls: Portal access limited to 11 named users
treatment_plan: MFA on the portal; firmware updates need two approvers

threat_event: False tank levels cause a utility to run short of hypochlorite
treatment_plan: Daily reconciliation for utility sites; anomaly alerts

threat_event: Customer portal account takeover leads to fraudulent orders
Ransomware on the warehouse management system stops branch shipping
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: WMS integration servers on the corporate network

threat_event: Repackaging line PLC logic is tampered with
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Line PLCs on the branch network

threat_event: Terminal T1 access control or CCTV records (SSI) are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Access control servers on the terminal office network
treatment_plan: Move to the security segment with the OT work

threat_event: Distribution security plan does not address cyber threats to shipping data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offeror security plan risk assessment is physical only
treatment_plan: Add cyber threats at the 2026 annual review

threat_event: A marine transfer control failure spills product into the water
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transfer controls on the terminal network

threat_event: The first SOC 2 Type 2 report is not ready by the end of 2027
Customer contact data is breached from the portal
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (where business contact data is covered)

threat_event: Third-party product SDS on the portal are out of date
A vessel connects equipment to the terminal network during a transfer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No ship-to-shore network connection is allowed

threat_event: A hurricane closes Terminal T1 while systems are being recovered
treatment_plan: Joint hurricane and cyber exercise in 2027
